Kerendia (finerenone) 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-421259  
Guideline Name 
Kerendia (finerenone)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Community & State Arizona  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
11/1/2025  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Kerendia  
Diagnosis 
Chronic Kidney Disease Associated with Type 2 Diabetes  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of chronic kidney disease (CKD) associated with type 2 diabetes (T2D)  


--- PDF page 996 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 996 
 
AND 
 
2 - Urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio (UACR) greater than or equal to 30 mg/g 
(milligrams/gram)  
 
AND 
 
3 - Estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) greater than or equal to 25 mL/min/1.73 m^2 
(milliliters/minute/1.73 square meter)  
 
AND 
 
4 - Serum potassium level less than or equal to 5.0 mEq/L (milliequivalents/liter) prior to 
initiating treatment  
 
AND 
 
5 - ONE of the following:  
 
 5.1 Minimum 30-day supply trial of a maximally tolerated dose and will continue therapy with 
ONE of the following:  
• 
Generic angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitor (e.g., benazepril, lisinopril)  
• 
Generic angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB) (e.g., losartan, valsartan)  
 
OR 
 
 5.2 Patient has a contraindication or intolerance to ACE inhibitors and ARBs  
 
AND 
 
6 - ONE of the following:  
 
 6.1 Patient is on a stable dose and will continue therapy with a sodium-glucose 
cotransporter-2 (SGLT2) inhibitor (e.g., Farxiga [dapagliflozin], Jardiance [empagliflozin])  


--- PDF page 997 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 997 
 
OR 
 
 6.2 Patient has a contraindication or intolerance to an SGLT2 inhibitor (e.g., Farxiga 
[dapagliflozin], Jardiance [empagliflozin])  
 
Product Name:Kerendia  
Diagnosis 
Chronic Kidney Disease Associated with Type 2 Diabetes  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Patient demonstrates positive clinical response to therapy  
 
AND 
 
2 - ONE of the following:  
 
 2.1 Patient continues to be on a maximally tolerated dose of ACE inhibitor or ARB  
 
OR 
 
 2.2 Patient has a contraindication or intolerance to ACE inhibitors and ARBs  
 
AND 
 
3 - ONE of the following:  
 
 3.1 Patient continues to be on an SGLT2 inhibitor (e.g., Farxiga [dapagliflozin], Jardiance 
[empagliflozin])  


--- PDF page 998 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 998 
 
OR 
 
 3.2 Patient has a contraindication or intolerance to an SGLT2 inhibitor (e.g., Farxiga 
[dapagliflozin], Jardiance [empagliflozin])  
 
Product Name:Kerendia  
Diagnosis 
Heart Failure with Left Ventricular Ejection Fraction (LVEF) ≥ 40%  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of heart failure  
 
AND 
 
2 - Patient has left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) greater than or equal to 40%  
 
AND 
 
3 - Patient has New York Heart Association (NYHA) Class II, III, or IV symptoms  
 
AND 
 
4 - Estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) greater than or equal to 25 mL/min/1.73 m^2 
(milliliters/minute/1.73 square meter)  
 
AND 


--- PDF page 999 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 999 
 
5 - Serum potassium level less than or equal to 5.0 mEq/L (milliequivalents/liter) prior to 
initiating treatment  
 
AND 
 
6 - BOTH of the following:  
 
 6.1 Patient is on diuretic treatment (e.g., bumetanide, furosemide) for the management of 
symptoms of heart failure for at least 30 days prior to initiating treatment  
 
AND 
 
 6.2 Patient is NOT receiving drug in combination with spironolactone or eplerenone  
 
AND 
 
7 - ONE of the following:  
 
 7.1 Patient is on a stable dose and will continue therapy with a sodium-glucose 
cotransporter-2 (SGLT2) inhibitor (e.g., Farxiga [dapagliflozin], Jardiance [empagliflozin])  
 
OR 
 
 7.2 Patient has a contraindication or intolerance to an SGLT2 inhibitor (e.g., Farxiga 
[dapagliflozin], Jardiance [empagliflozin])  
 
AND 
 
8 - Prescribed by or in consultation with a cardiologist  
 
Product Name:Kerendia  
Diagnosis 
Heart Failure with Left Ventricular Ejection Fraction (LVEF) ≥ 40%  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization

Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Patient demonstrates positive clinical response to therapy  
 
AND 
 
2 - ONE of the following:  
 
 2.1 Patient continues to be on an SGLT2 inhibitor (e.g., Farxiga [dapagliflozin], Jardiance 
[empagliflozin])  
 
OR 
 
 2.2 Patient has a contraindication or intolerance to an SGLT2 inhibitor (e.g., Farxiga 
[dapagliflozin], Jardiance [empagliflozin])
